title: Aqua Heart Drops
category: Earrings (open C-arc drop on a straight post, sold as 1 pair; the 2 earrings match)
metal: rhodium silver tone (listing: PVD rhodium coating), bright mirror polish, tall ball-tipped claw prongs; one tone only
lock: 2 earrings, each a 29 mm open C-arc on a straight post: 5 large round brilliant clear cubic zirconia in tall ball-tipped claws along the front (top and bottom stones smaller), a small fan of about 3 upright clear baguettes on the inner wall at the lower tip, and from that tip, on 1 small loop, 1 pale aqua-blue heart-cut stone (about 8 mm) in 3 claws, point down. Rhodium silver tone, high polish. The arc must stay an open C of 5 big claw-set round stones, never a closed hoop or a long row of small pave stones.
morph: The arc's stone row. Image models shrink the 5 big claw-set brilliants into a long row of 12 or more small pave stones with a strip of side baguettes, stretch the arc, or close the C into a full hoop or huggie. The live listing already has this drift: photo 06 (aqua-heart-drops-worn-profile.jpg) shows that long small-stone hoop. It copies an old supplier photo (WE22108C3_5, kept as edition-one/build/refs/aqua/listing-5.jpg) of a different, bigger 2-row hoop. That file is no longer on the listing, but the lock in performance/build/products_g4.json used it as its second reference. Second risk: the heart. Models turn it deep sapphire, teal or pink, add a second heart or a halo, bezel it, or hang it point up or inside the C. The 3 claws (1 on each lobe, 1 at the point) and the open side gallery get smoothed away.
sizeMm: Drop 29 mm, post to tip (listing and size guide, 'give or take 1 mm'). Estimated against the size guide's own 29 mm bar (about 27.8 px per mm on the 1600 px file): the C-arc is about 18 mm tall and 9 mm across, the round stones about 3.5 to 4 mm, and the heart about 7.5 mm wide and 8.5 mm tall with its claws (the stone alone about 6.5 x 7.5 mm). That is smaller than the 10 mm heart an earlier lock gave. Body referent: worn (supplier photo 02), the arc sits on the earlobe and the heart hangs just below it. The whole drop is about the length of the top joint of an adult thumb. In photo 04 the cardamom pod is a little under twice the heart's width.

At this angle 6 stones show (2 half-hidden at the ends), so don't count from it. 04 both earrings three-quarter from above, beside a cardamom pod; the post, baguette fan, 5 stones per arc, and the heart's 3 claws and open gallery are all sharp, and it matches 01. Show the pair as in 01, both arcs open to the back with the hearts hanging point down.
story: A clean crescent of 5 big claw-set brilliants that ends in 1 icy aqua heart, the only colour on the piece. It reads as sparkle with one soft secret, like a 'something blue' for a reception or cocktail night (the shop-all set cast it as the Reception pair). It rhymes with sea glass, ice, blue pigment, and cool-toned outfits with hair tucked back (the listing's own styling tip and photos 07-08). Against the earlier camps: it fits the LILAC camp (lilac paper, lavender, rhodium pieces, aubergine ink), where cool blue on lavender keeps the heart reading. It also fits the Red Room, where an earlier rating noted the pale aqua heart and clear arc show well on maroon velvet. Both camps verified every frame against the listing at full resolution and rejected frames that showed a different piece. That rule matters here because of photo 06.
copyNotes: Use: 'Aqua Heart Drops', 'pale aqua-blue heart', 'icy blue', 'open C', 'curve of light', 'round brilliants', 'baguettes', 'cubic zirconia', 'rhodium silver tone', 'PVD rhodium coating', '29 mm', 'drop', 'pre-order', 'Rs 1,299' / '₹1,299' (the live price; earlier sets used ₹1,499 and Edition One ₹1,999). Avoid: 'aquamarine', 'topaz', 'sapphire', 'diamond' (it is cubic zirconia; those words also imply a gemstone claim and pull the wrong blue), bare 'silver', 'sterling', '925' or 'white gold' (say 'rhodium silver tone'), 'huggie' or bare 'hoop' (it is an open C on a post; 'hoop' pulls a closed ring), 'pave' or 'micro pave' (the stones are big and claw-set), 'two hearts' or 'hearts' for one earring. No claims: never say waterproof, tarnish free, anti-tarnish or hypoallergenic (no such tags), and show no water, pool or shower imagery (the care text says 'Keep it dry'). It is tagged pre-order, so do not promise immediate dispatch.
